name: incident_form
notes: 17 fields the LLM fills (one-letter keys to keep decode short) + 1 field built by code (x). Mandatory fields are asked for in the order given by 'ask_order'. Field choices follow OSHA Form 301 and the Indian Factories Act Form 18; see eval/nlu/SOURCES.md.

t.name: incident_type
t.ask: What kind of incident was it?
t.standard: Form 18: cause or nature of accident or dangerous occurrence

s.name: severity
s.ask: How severe is it: low, medium, high or critical?

d.name: date_time
d.standard: OSHA 301 #11 date, #13 time of event; Form 18: date, shift and hour

p.name: people_involved
p.standard: OSHA 301 #1 / Form 18: person injured (role, not PII)

n.name: injured_count
n.standard: Form 18 / OSHA SIR: number of persons injured

i.name: injury_nature
i.standard: OSHA 301 #16: what was the injury or illness

b.name: body_part
b.standard: OSHA 301 #16: part of the body affected

m.name: medical_care
m.standard: OSHA 301 #18 treated in emergency room, #19 hospitalized overnight

g.name: activity_before
g.standard: OSHA 301 #14: what was the employee doing just before the incident

c.name: cause
c.standard: OSHA 301 #17: object or substance that directly harmed; Form 18: cause

e.name: equipment
e.standard: Form 18: name of the machine and part causing the accident

o.name: notified_or_responding
o.standard: teams/authorities informed or responding (fire brigade, ambulance, security, EHS)

h.name: hazard_status
h.standard: Form 18-A dangerous occurrence / is the area still unsafe

x.name: description
x.standard: OSHA 301 #15 what happened. Built by code from the user's own words, never by the LLM

tools.update_report: args: any subset of the 17 LLM fields
